_source: Placement library (2/N). Kundli-matching compatibility tier, keyed by band: excellent (>=70%) | good (>=55%) | average (>=40%) | low (<40%). Consumed by InterpretationService for the `matching` domain so it returns a KB-assembled reading instead of calling the LLM. Payload mirrors InterpretationResult. English-authored; run `npm run kb:backfill -- --tables=matching-tiers` to fill the other 11 locales (until then non-English requests fall through to the localized LLM path via renderStatus().matched).
_shape: { summary: string, points: string[], guidance: string }

en.summary: This is a strong, well-aligned match — the two charts support each other across most of the key areas of life.
points: Core temperaments and values line up well, which makes everyday harmony come more naturally.
Emotional and mental compatibility is solid — a good base for trust and easy communication.
Most kootas score well, so the traditional indicators are largely in your favour.
No match is effortless — keep nurturing the bond rather than taking it for granted.
en.guidance: Build on this strong foundation with open communication and shared goals. Where any single area scored lower, treat it as something to stay mindful of, not a dealbreaker.

en.summary: This is a good, workable match — there's real compatibility here, with a few areas that will benefit from understanding and effort.
points: Many of the key indicators align, giving you a solid foundation to build on.
A few kootas scored lower — these point to areas where your styles differ and patience helps.
Differences like these are normal and manageable with communication and mutual respect.
Traditional remedies exist for specific low areas (such as Manglik or Nadi) if you wish to address them.
en.guidance: Lean on the areas that scored well as your strengths, and approach the weaker ones with empathy. A frank conversation about expectations goes a long way.

en.summary: This is a moderate match — there's a foundation to work with, alongside some meaningful differences worth understanding before you commit.
points: Some important areas align while others don't, so the relationship will ask for conscious effort.
Lower-scoring kootas highlight where temperaments, emotions, or values may clash.
Manglik or Nadi considerations, if present, are worth reviewing with an experienced astrologer.
Compatibility is also built, not just inherited — shared intent matters as much as the score.
en.guidance: Look closely at which specific areas scored low and talk through them honestly. Traditional remedies and, above all, mutual understanding can bridge many of these gaps.

en.summary: The traditional indicators for this match are on the lower side — it doesn't mean the relationship can't work, but it does ask for awareness and effort.
points: Several key kootas scored low, pointing to notable differences in temperament or values.
Specific factors such as Nadi or Manglik dosha may need attention if they are present.
A low score reflects classical compatibility metrics, not the love, effort, and growth two people bring.
Many strong relationships thrive despite a modest score — read this as a caution, not a verdict.
en.guidance: If you're serious about each other, consider reviewing the specific low areas with an astrologer and exploring traditional remedies. Honest communication and shared commitment matter most.
